It's a bit unwieldy, so it requires a well-practiced technique to use efficiently.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 18 |durability = 52 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Double Axe}} Double Axes are [[Axe]]s that have been designed with fighting in mind, though they require practice to use efficiently. They can be found either abandoned or being used by [[Monster]]s in [[West Necluda]] and the [[Gerudo Highlands]]. As with the [[Woodcutter's Axe]], the Double Axe has a damage multiplier when used against [[Tree]]s, allowing them to be felled in one swing. Being made of metal, Double Axes will attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]] and conduct [[Electricity]]. However, they will not burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]], and they can be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Lsword_030" |Life = 52 |Power = 18 |SpHitActor = "Tree", "Scaffold", "Signboard" |SpHitRatio = 7.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 9 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 16 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 5 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 9 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 17 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 22 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 10 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 21 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 0.7 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 4 |BuyingPrice = 24 }} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link Two-Handed Weapon }} The Double Axe appears in {{AoC}} as a two-handed [[Weapon]] wielded by [[King Rhoam]] while he is in his hermit disguise.
